units.source_text: 源氏公子答道：“这是那班浅见之人的过虑而已。

en.t: Prince Genji replied, "That is only needless worry from those narrow-minded people.

units.source_text: 我往日曾经静候双方谅解，其间有时不免久疏问候。

en.t: In the past, I quietly waited for both sides to understand, and during that time I sometimes could not help letting my greetings grow long neglected.

units.source_text: 但现在还有什么理由可说而不来探访呢？

en.t: But now, what reason could I still give for not coming to visit?
From now on, I trust that my feelings will be understood."
After saying this, he took his leave and went out.
